verdict.rationale: Godot runs its own first-party Asset Library, with categories for 2D/3D tools, shaders, materials, scripts, templates and demos. It is queryable through a keyless JSON API, and the editor plugin system lets these add-ons extend the editor. Nothing in the pack shows the library is large, or that it offers ready-made 3D models as a category. Missing for 10: evidence of ecosystem scale or breadth, explicit ready-made model or art assets, a commercial asset-store dimension, and independent or hands-on corroboration of library quality.

support.subject: As a game developer, a large asset store or package ecosystem gives me ready-made models, tools, and plugins
